notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-perform-range (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): HANDLE CONDITION labels inside a PERFORM THRU range, an ERROR catch-all outside it, RESP and IGNORE overriding HANDLE. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: three-items
scenarios.why: HCQ1 holds three 3-byte items: the loop reads them, ITEMERR on item 4 jumps to PAST-END inside the PERFORM range, which returns to MAIN-PARA

scenarios.name: no-queue
scenarios.why: HCQ1 does not exist: QIDERR jumps to NO-QUEUE, which falls through PAST-END into READ-ITEMS-EXIT and returns from the PERFORM

scenarios.name: five-items
scenarios.why: HCQ1 holds five items: the loop ends normally and control falls through NO-QUEUE and PAST-END although no condition occurred

scenarios.name: length-trap
scenarios.why: item 1 is 1 byte, so LENGTH is left at 1; item 2 is 5 bytes: LENGERR, no specific handler, so the ERROR label outside the PERFORM range takes it
